newsitem.title: USA: Con Edison sees delay in further talks.
newsitem.headline: Con Edison sees delay in further talks.

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc believes further negotiations on its restructuring settlement with the staff of the New York Public Service Commission could delay the coming of competition, spokesman Richard Mulieri said Friday.
He was responding to questions about Adminsitrative Law Judge Judith Lee's Recommended Decision in the case.
Lee called for another 30 days of negotiations among the parties to settlement.
Mulieri said the utility's initial review found the decision "supports many things in the March 12 settlement."
Decling to comment on specific recommendations for changes in the settlement, he said it was the "best compromise."
